ruleset.name: Handwritten backend architecture
ruleset.description: Production source rules; tests and explicit generated-source roots are excluded.

rule.name: RequireTypeImports
rule.message: Import the class and use its simple name instead of a fully qualified type name.
rule.description: Require imports for qualified type references, including annotations and static-call qualifiers. A conflicting explicit import or a same-named declared type permits qualification.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassType[@FullyQualified = true()][ let $name := @SimpleName, $full := concat(@PackageQualifier, '.', @SimpleName), $scopes := ancestor::*, $site := . return not( root(.)//ImportDeclaration[@ImportOnDemand = false() and @ImportedSimpleName = $name and @ImportedName != $full] or root(.)//*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::AnnotationTypeDeclaration] [@SimpleName = $name and not(@CanonicalName = $full)] [parent::CompilationUnit or exists(. intersect $scopes) or exists(parent::ClassBody/parent::* intersect $scopes) or (exists((parent::Block | parent::LocalClassStatement/parent::Block) intersect $scopes) and . << $site)] ) ]
